subject: Literature
subcategory: The Art of the Short Story
title: Poe and the Invention of the Modern Short Story
description: A short lesson to help you apply Poe and the Invention of the Modern Short Story.

hook.text: Edgar Allan Poe declared that a short story should be readable in one sitting and create a single unified effect.

buildup.text: He applied this theory in stories like The Tell-Tale Heart and The Fall of the House of Usher.

discovery.text: Poe also invented the detective story with The Murders in the Rue Morgue, creating an entirely new genre.

twist.text: Despite inventing two major literary forms, Poe died penniless and was mocked by American critics for decades.

climax.text: It was the French, not Americans, who first recognized Poe as a literary genius and championed his work.

punchline.text: America's greatest story inventor was honored by France first.

quiz.question: What literary form did Poe invent besides the modern short story?
